# endpointcentral_custom_group (Resource)

Manages an Endpoint Central custom group (a machine or user group).

* **static** and **static_unique** groups start empty. Add members with `endpointcentral_custom_group_membership` (one member each, leaves other members alone) or `endpointcentral_custom_group_memberships_exclusive` (the complete member list). A computer can belong to only one static unique group.
* **dynamic** groups (computers only) compute their members from `criteria`.

Updating this resource never changes a static group's members.

`type` and `category` cannot be changed after creation; changing them replaces the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Static group. Its members are separate resources
# (endpointcentral_custom_group_membership or ..._memberships_exclusive).
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group" "engineering" {
  name        = "engineering-macs"
  description = "Macs with the dev role"
}

# Static unique group: a computer can only be in one static unique group.
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group" "privileged" {
  name     = "privileged-servers"
  category = "static_unique"
}

# Dynamic group: membership is computed from criteria. Column IDs are tenant
# specific; look them up with GET /api/1.4/customgroup/dynamic/criteriaPattern.
resource "endpointcentral_custom_group" "test_lab" {
  name             = "test-lab"
  category         = "dynamic"
  criteria_pattern = "1 AND 2"
  criteria = [
    { column_id = 7, comparator = "equal", values = ["Mac"] },
    { column_id = 12, comparator = "contains", values = ["VirtualMac"] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name. Must be unique and is case-sensitive (max 100 characters; must not contain `` ` \ : ; < > ? * " | & # % / ``).

### Optional

- `category` (String) Group category: `static` (default), `static_unique` or `dynamic`.
- `criteria` (Attributes List) Membership rules of a `dynamic` group. Column IDs, comparators and values are tenant specific; discover them with the `GET /api/1.4/customgroup/dynamic/criteriaPattern` and `.../dynamic/columnValues` APIs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))
- `criteria_pattern` (String) How `criteria` entries are combined, using 1-based indices, e.g. `(1 OR 2) AND 3`. Defaults to joining all criteria with `AND`.
- `description` (String) Group description (max 250 characters). The API does not return the description, so changes made outside OpenTofu/Terraform are not detected.
- `type` (String) Member type: `computer` (default) or `user`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom group resource ID.

<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Required:

- `column_id` (Number) Criteria column ID.
- `comparator` (String) Comparison operator, e.g. `equal`, `contains`, `starts with`.
- `values` (List of String) Values to compare against. Multiple values are OR-ed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric group ID
tofu import endpointcentral_custom_group.servers 301

# ...or by exact (case-sensitive) group name
tofu import endpointcentral_custom_group.servers "Windows Servers"
```
